profiles.notes: 2027 international-curriculum requirements; all cohort includes SA citizens studying international curricula. Each condition retains its own qualification, location and campus applicability. Programme subject minima and converted averages are additional to matriculation exemption; no single course IB total is inferred.

requirements.label: Selection and capacity
requirements.details: Meeting a programme's minimum requirements does not guarantee admission. Places are limited and faculty/programme selection guidelines also apply.

requirements.label: Matriculation exemption for international curricula
requirements.details: Applicants with an international curriculum or a school system other than NSC/IEB must meet Universities South Africa (USAf) matriculation-exemption requirements and the chosen degree's subject grades/levels. The general guidance says the certificate need not be applied for before the SU application; candidates should complete the USAf online assessment. It allows a certificate application after registration following final admission, with separate offices for SA citizens and international/refugee/asylum/permanent-resident applicants. The American-diploma section separately gives an earlier pre-offer condition for that qualification; follow its applicable branch.

requirements.label: IB matriculation exemption alternatives
requirements.details: The Matriculation Board header lists 24 points OR two HL subjects passed at grades 4–7 and three SL subjects passed at grades 4–7, with English Language. These are alternative matriculation-exemption conditions. The programme's converted average and subject minima remain additional requirements; 24 is not presented as a single sufficient course admission offer.

requirements.label: A-level and GCSE/O-level exemption combination
requirements.details: For the Cambridge A-level/Pearson Edexcel A-level route, the header requires two A-level passes at A–E plus three GCSE/O-level passes at A–C and English First Language. The course-specific subject grades are additional. This is an A-level route, not the separate AS-level route.

requirements.label: AS-level and GCSE/O-level exemption combination
requirements.details: For Cambridge AS-level/Namibia AS-level (NSSCAS), the header lists four AS-level passes at A–D plus one GCSE/O-level pass at A–C. Cambridge applicants require English First Language; NSSCAS allows English First or Second Language. Programme-specific subject grades are additional.

requirements.label: German Abitur exemption qualification
requirements.details: The German Abitur column's Matriculation Board header requires Abitur and English Language. Programme-specific language, Mathematics, science and converted-average conditions apply in addition.

requirements.label: Namibian higher/ordinary-level exemption combination
requirements.details: For the Namibia HL/OL route, the header lists four HL subjects passed at grades 1–3 and one OL subject passed at A–C, with English First or Second Language on HL. If English is Second Language, another First Language is required on HL or OL. This is separate from NSSCAS.

requirements.label: How international grades and programme averages are read
requirements.details: SU converts international letter/number results to its percentage scale before assessment. The faculty tables' required average percentages use that converted scale, not an IB diploma total, raw AP examination mark or guaranteed offer. Conversion and the qualification-specific subject/level requirements must be considered together.

requirements.label: Agrisciences: 60% converted average
requirements.details: For these linked Agrisciences programmes at Stellenbosch campus, university exemption and a converted average of at least 60% are required, together with the separately stated qualification-specific subject conditions.

requirements.label: Data Science: 80% converted average
requirements.details: The B Data Science (BDatSci) row at Stellenbosch campus requires university exemption and at least an 80% converted average, together with its additional English and Mathematics conditions.

requirements.label: Elsenburg: 55% converted average
requirements.details: BAgric (Agricultural Production and Management) is listed at Elsenburg campus. It requires university exemption and at least a 55% converted average, plus the listed qualification-specific subjects. This is a different programme/campus from BAgric (Agribusiness Management).

requirements.label: IB: Afrikaans or English language grades
requirements.details: For the linked rows, Afrikaans or English, as First or Second Language, requires at least grade 4 at HL or grade 5 at SL.

requirements.label: IB: Mathematics HL 4 or SL 5
requirements.details: Mathematics requires at least grade 4 at HL or grade 5 at SL for these linked course rows. The table does not identify AA/AI variants; none is inferred.

requirements.label: IB: Physics and Chemistry
requirements.details: The linked course rows require both Physics and Chemistry at grade 4 at HL or grade 5 at SL. The Forestry and Wood Science row gives these same IB science minima for both listed specialisations.

requirements.label: Plant and Soil Science: incomplete IB SL entries
requirements.details: The Plant and Soil Science row specifies Afrikaans or English First/Second Language at HL 4, but prints no SL number. Its default Mathematics line also gives HL 4 and omits the SL number. When Soil Science and Chemistry are majors, Mathematics is explicitly HL 4 or SL 5. Missing SL values are not inferred from neighbouring programmes.

requirements.label: Viticulture: unclear IB Mathematics connective
requirements.details: The source prints Mathematics as “5 on SL R Maths 4 on HL”. The two score/level values are visible, but the connective is malformed. Confirm the intended alternative with the faculty; this record does not silently turn the line into an unqualified either/or requirement.

requirements.label: Data Science: IB English alternatives
requirements.details: For Data Science, English First Language requires HL 4; English Second Language requires HL 5 or SL 6. The First Language option is not broadened to an unstated SL equivalent.

requirements.label: Data Science: IB Mathematics
requirements.details: For Data Science, Mathematics requires HL 5 or SL 6. No AA/AI variant is specified in this table. The 80% converted-average requirement is additional.

requirements.label: A-level route: language
requirements.details: For the linked rows, Afrikaans or English First/Second Language requires E at A-level or C at GCSE/O-level. The separate matriculation-exemption English First Language rule remains applicable.

requirements.label: A-level route: Mathematics grade E
requirements.details: The linked programme rows require Mathematics at A-level grade E. This is additional to the two-A-level/three-GCSE exemption combination.

requirements.label: A-level route: Physics and Chemistry grade E
requirements.details: The linked programme rows require both Physics and Chemistry at A-level grade E.

requirements.label: Forestry: A-level Mathematics by specialisation
requirements.details: Forestry and Natural Resources Science requires Mathematics E at A-level. Wood and Wood Products Science requires Mathematics D at A-level. These are branches within BSc (Forestry and Wood Science), not separate awards.

requirements.label: Plant and Soil Science: A-level Mathematics by majors
requirements.details: The default A-level Mathematics requirement is E; if Soil Science and Chemistry are taken as majors, Mathematics D at A-level is required.

requirements.label: Data Science: A-level English and Mathematics
requirements.details: Data Science requires Mathematics C at A-level. English First Language is E at A-level or C at GCSE/O-level; English Second Language is C at A-level or B at GCSE/O-level. The separate qualification-exemption requirements remain additional.

requirements.label: AS-level route: language
requirements.details: For the linked rows, Afrikaans or English First/Second Language requires D at AS-level or C at GCSE/O-level. The exemption header separately distinguishes Cambridge First Language and NSSCAS First/Second Language.

requirements.label: AS-level route: Mathematics grade C
requirements.details: The linked programme rows require Mathematics C at AS-level.

requirements.label: AS-level route: Physics and Chemistry grade D
requirements.details: The linked programme rows require both Physics and Chemistry D at AS-level.

requirements.label: Forestry: AS-level Mathematics by specialisation
requirements.details: Forestry and Natural Resources Science requires Mathematics C at AS-level. Wood and Wood Products Science requires Mathematics B at AS-level.

requirements.label: Plant and Soil Science: AS-level Mathematics by majors
requirements.details: The default Mathematics requirement is C at AS-level. If Soil Science and Chemistry are taken as majors, Mathematics B at AS-level is required.

requirements.label: Data Science: AS-level English and Mathematics
requirements.details: Data Science requires Mathematics A at AS-level. English First Language requires C at AS-level/GCSE/O-level; English Second Language requires C at AS-level or A at GCSE/O-level.

requirements.label: Elsenburg: AS-level Mathematics
requirements.details: BAgric (Agricultural Production and Management) at Elsenburg requires Mathematics D at AS-level.

requirements.label: Abitur route: language
requirements.details: For the linked rows, Afrikaans or English First/Second Language is grade 4 in the German Abitur column, with the source's Namibian German-school equivalent shown as 6.

requirements.label: Abitur route: Mathematics
requirements.details: For the linked rows, Mathematics is grade 6 in the German Abitur column; the source's Namibian German-school equivalent is 8. These are not IB grades.

requirements.label: Abitur route: Physics and Chemistry
requirements.details: Both Physics and Chemistry are grade 4 in the German Abitur column, with Namibian German-school equivalent 6, for the linked rows.

requirements.label: Forestry: Abitur specialisation conditions
requirements.details: For Forestry and Natural Resources Science, the Abitur column requires Mathematics 6 (Namibian German-school equivalent 8) and Physics AND Chemistry 4 (Namibian equivalent 6). For Wood and Wood Products Science, Mathematics is 8 (Namibian equivalent 10) and Physics AND Chemistry 6 (Namibian equivalent 8).

requirements.label: Plant and Soil Science: Abitur Mathematics by majors
requirements.details: The Abitur Mathematics requirement is 6 (Namibian German-school equivalent 8); if Soil Science and Chemistry are majors, it is 8 (Namibian equivalent 10).

requirements.label: Data Science: Abitur English and Mathematics
requirements.details: Data Science requires English First Language 6 (Namibian German-school equivalent 6), OR English Second Language 9 (Namibian equivalent 7); Mathematics is 11 (Namibian equivalent 12). These values belong to the German-school column.

requirements.label: Elsenburg: Abitur Mathematics
requirements.details: For Elsenburg BAgric (Agricultural Production and Management), the German Abitur column requires Mathematics 4 (Namibian German-school equivalent 6).

requirements.label: Namibia HL/OL route: language
requirements.details: For the linked rows, Afrikaans or English First/Second Language requires grade 3 at HL or B at OL. The separate exemption condition also requires another First Language if English is Second Language. These HL/OL levels are Namibian qualifications, not IB.

requirements.label: Namibia HL/OL route: Mathematics grade 3
requirements.details: The linked rows require Mathematics grade 3 at Namibian HL.

requirements.label: Namibia HL/OL route: Physics and Chemistry grade 3
requirements.details: Both Physics and Chemistry require grade 3 at Namibian HL for the linked rows.

requirements.label: Forestry: Namibian HL Mathematics by specialisation
requirements.details: Forestry and Natural Resources Science requires Mathematics 3 at Namibian HL; Wood and Wood Products Science requires Mathematics 2 at Namibian HL.

requirements.label: Plant and Soil Science: mislabelled Namibian Mathematics line
requirements.details: In the Namibia HL/OL column, the default Mathematics line is incorrectly labelled “E on A-Level”. It is not imported as a Namibian grade. The same column explicitly requires Mathematics 2 on HL when Soil Science and Chemistry are majors. Confirm the default route with the faculty.

requirements.label: Data Science: Namibian English and Mathematics
requirements.details: English First Language requires 3 at HL or A at OL, OR English Second Language requires 2 at HL. Mathematics requires 1 at Namibian HL. These are not IB HL scores.

requirements.label: Elsenburg: science alternatives need grouping confirmation
requirements.details: The Elsenburg row lists Chemistry AND Physics or Biology or Agricultural Sciences without clarifying the grouping of AND/OR. The displayed minimum is IB 5 at SL or 4 at HL; Cambridge A-level E; AS-level D; German Abitur 4 (Namibian German-school equivalent 6); and Namibia 3 at HL or B at OL. These are qualification-specific numbers. The exact science-subject combination must be confirmed; this entry does not impose Chemistry on every listed alternative.

requirements.label: American diploma completed in South Africa: diploma and GPA
requirements.details: For an American High School Diploma completed within South Africa, the booklet requires the High School Diploma and transcript with GPA 3.5, plus ONE of the SAT/AP/ACT/NBT exemption-document routes stated separately. This is a qualification/location-specific exemption condition, additional to programme admission requirements.

requirements.label: American diploma completed in South Africa: test alternatives
requirements.details: For the within-South-Africa AHSD branch, ONE exemption-document alternative is needed: SAT Evidence-based Reading/Writing 610 and Mathematics 530; OR results in two College Board AP subjects at grades 3–5; OR ACT mean 22 with English 22 and Mathematics 21; OR NBT proficient Academic Literacy, Quantitative Literacy and Mathematics for STEM, with Academic Literacy and Quantitative Literacy for programmes without a Mathematics minimum. This is not a requirement to submit every listed test.

profiles.notes: 2027 international-curriculum requirements; all cohort includes SA citizens studying international curricula. Each condition retains its own qualification, location and campus applicability. Programme subject minima and converted averages are additional to matriculation exemption; no single course IB total is inferred.

requirements.label: International applicants from USA: diploma and AP alternative
requirements.details: For an international applicant applying from the USA, the booklet requires an American High School Graduation Diploma and lists at least two College Board AP subjects at grades 3–5 as one alternative route. GED is explicitly not accepted in this branch. The AP condition is an exemption/qualification alternative, not a universal independent AP threshold for every course. Programme-specific subject and converted-average requirements are additional. The source separately lists an accreditation-body and an SAT branch.

requirements.label: International USA SAT route: inconsistent source total
requirements.details: For international applicants applying from the USA, the booklet prints SAT total 1130 with subminima Evidence-based Reading/Writing 610 and Mathematics 530. The subminima sum to 1140, so the source is internally inconsistent. Confirm this SAT route; no corrected total or sufficient numeric admission threshold is inferred. This is separate from the within-South-Africa AHSD document branch.

requirements.label: International USA diploma: exemption certificate timing
requirements.details: The American-diploma section says applicants with AHSD must apply for matriculation exemption before receiving an offer. The general exemption page says the certificate application need not precede the SU application and may follow registration after final admission. The qualification-specific earlier pre-offer instruction must be checked for the applicable AHSD route; it is not silently replaced by the general timing.

requirements.label: International application calendar and fee
requirements.details: The 2027 prospectus's reference guide for international applicants lists undergraduate/student-housing opening on 1 April; a compulsory R400 application fee; 31 July closing for undergraduate applications and housing, with no late applications; and 31 July for programme-change requests. Requests go to info@sun.ac.za with subject “Request for programme change”. It aims to finalise international applications by 31 August and lists 30 November as the date to obtain an admission offer for visa processing. Calendar years are not printed beside these dates, and the latter dates are not represented as extra application-closing extensions.
